journey.name: public profile after restart
journey.description: Verifies that the same saved public profile can be read and copied after an app restart. Precondition: an onboarded E2E wallet with a published name, bio, link and tag, PIN off, and network access. Viewing public data does not authorize profile edits or payments. If private session restoration is still pending, edit and tag changes stay disabled until it succeeds. This journey does not require a pending lock; controlled lock contention needs a separate fixture. Use the dedicated test simulator UDID for <UDID>.

actions.action: Open Profile from the header profile button (id "ProfileButton")
Wait for the profile name (id "ProfileViewName") and note its name, bio, links and tags
Tap Copy (id "ProfileCopy") and note the public key shown in the copied popup
Open Profile from the header profile button (id "ProfileButton")
Wait for the profile name (id "ProfileViewName") and verify the saved name, bio, links and tags match
Verify the QR code (id "ProfileQRCode") and Copy (id "ProfileCopy") are available
Tap Copy and verify the copied popup shows the same public key

Dismiss the copied popup. While Edit (id "ProfileEdit") is disabled, verify Add Tag (id "ProfileAddTag") is disabled and existing tags have no remove action. Check Retry (id "ProfileRetry") and open then cancel Disconnect (id "ProfileSignOut") only if Edit is still disabled; if restoration finishes first, skip the read-only controls check
If Edit is still disabled after loading finishes, tap Retry (id "ProfileRetry"). Wait for restoration and profile loading to enable Edit. The read-only Retry and Disconnect footer then disappears
Tap Edit and verify the edit form opens with the saved profile values; cancel without changing them
